summary: This document describes the Schnorr non-interactive zero-knowledge proof, a variant of the three-pass Schnorr identification scheme. It lets someone prove they know a discrete logarithm without revealing it, and it can serve as a building block for other cryptographic protocols.

eli5.summary: It is a way to prove you know a secret without ever telling the secret. Like showing you can open a lock without handing over the key.

questions: what is a schnorr zero-knowledge proof
how to prove knowledge of a secret without revealing it
